summary: The base reproduced the original apply-dispatch contradiction: a layer cached as FLASHINFER_CUTLASS raised Unsupported ... FLASHINFER_CUTLASS when the live speculative global was TRITON or AUTO. At the exact candidate commit, the same actual apply() calls selected the cached CUTLASS branch. The candidate also made the CuTeDSL and TRT-LLM guards use the same per-layer local already used by MegaMoE and Marlin; independent checks covered reverse target/draft state, missing cached state, routed TRT-LLM, and all supported branch predicates. No native source changed. The original 8xB300 adaptive EAGLE startup and FlashInfer CUDA kernels could not run on the available single AMD MI355X ROCm host.

tests.what_was_measured: Actual ModelOptNvFp4FusedMoEMethod.apply dispatch with external runner modules stubbed only at their boundary: 4 failed and 4 passed. Both cached CUTLASS/live TRITON-or-AUTO cases reproduced the issue's contradictory NotImplementedError; cached TRT-LLM and CuTeDSL/live TRITON also failed on their global guards.
Candidate regression through actual apply(): 8 passed, covering cached CUTLASS against live TRITON/AUTO, missing cached state, reverse draft/target state, TRT-LLM, CuTeDSL, MegaMoE, and Marlin.

Independent adversarial apply-dispatch cases: cached target wins over a disagreeing live global, missing cache reads the live global, cached draft TRITON is not overridden by target CUTLASS, routed TRT-LLM selects correctly, and AST/source checks confirm all supported apply branch guards use moe_runner_backend. 5 passed.

One AMD Instinct MI355X was visible through ROCm 7.2 and produced 1240.0 for a device sum-of-squares reference of 1240. This establishes GPU access only; it does not validate NVIDIA NVFP4/FlashInfer kernels.

gpu_execution.evidence: A simple torch device numerical probe executed on one AMD Instinct MI355X (gfx950-equivalent capability reported as 9.5) with ROCm 7.2. Candidate dispatch tests themselves stopped at mocked external kernel boundaries because FlashInfer CUDA/B300 was unavailable.

remaining_limitations: The reported 8xNVIDIA B300 sm_103 TP8/EP8 adaptive EAGLE CUDA-graph startup was not runnable on this single AMD MI355X ROCm 7.2 host and remains unverified.
FlashInfer CUTLASS/TRT-LLM/CuTeDSL CUDA kernels and NVFP4 numerical output were not executed; tests instrumented only their runner/quant-info boundary.

The existing getattr(self, '_moe_runner_backend', get_moe_runner_backend()) expression eagerly invokes the global getter even when the cache exists. Its returned value is non-authoritative after this patch, so no dispatch counterexample was found, but the incidental read remains.
No native files changed in the candidate, repository-environment.json declares no native rebuild target, and therefore no native rebuild was applicable.
